items.text: REA is a free, open-source tool that runs locally and lets your coding agent study any app, break down how it works, and rebuild its features in your own project.

items.title: Run Your Coding Tool on Free and Cheap AI with OmniRoute
items.text: OmniRoute is a free local proxy that connects your coding tool to 200+ AI providers, routes each prompt to the cheapest option, and falls back when one runs out.

items.question: Is the library really free?
items.answer: Yes. Every guide, prompt and template is free. You apply once so we can send you new workflows as they go live.

items.question: What do I get after signing up?
items.answer: Instant access to every workflow from Outskill's videos, each written out step by step with copy-ready prompts.

items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. Most guides need no code at all, and the ones that do walk you through every command.
